title: The Unwanted Power
summary: Ha-Jun struggles desperately to control his superhuman physical strength and heightened senses in daily life. At school, Min-Jae confronts him with a suspicious note just as a mandatory Bloodline Quest appears—commanding him to enter the subterranean void beneath the campus.

panels.action: Early morning sunlight cuts through plastic window blinds, illuminating dust motes dancing over Ha-Jun's modest bed.
Ha-Jun reaches his hand to switch off the plastic alarm clock; his thumb lightly presses down, shattering the plastic casing into pieces.
Ha-Jun sits up in bed staring in disbelief at the shattered plastic gears in his palm: 'M-Maine toh bas halke se chhua tha!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Maine toh bas halka sa dabaya tha...!

panels.action: In the bathroom sink, Ha-Jun tries to turn the brass faucet; the solid metal twists like clay under his fingers, spraying water across the mirror.
Kuro perches on the shower rod, snickering: 'Tumhari muscle density barah guna badh gayi hai. Insaani dimaag abhi calibrate nahi hua.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Insaani dimaag ko Sovereign ki taqat samajhne mein waqt lagta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun looks into the wet mirror: His face is sharper, bruises completely vanished, but his irises flicker violet when he gets agitated.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Agar school mein kisi ko chhooya... toh haddi toot jayegi!

panels.action: Ha-Jun clutches the edges of the porcelain sink, taking deep measured breaths: 'Mujhe isse control karna hoga.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Control... mujhe is taqat ko control karna hoga.

panels.action: Kuro: 'Mana ko apne core mein khencho. Bahar bahaav ko band karo jab tak jung ka waqt na ho.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Mana ko andar kheench kar rakh, ladke.

panels.action: Ha-Jun walks gingerly through a packed morning commuter subway platform, stepping with extreme care as if walking on thin glass.
A hurried salaryman bumps hard into Ha-Jun's shoulder—and bounces straight backward as if hitting a reinforced titanium pillar.
The man rubs his shoulder in agony: 'Arey yaar! Yeh ladka lohe ka bana hai kya?!'

dialogue.text: Lohe ka bana hai kya yeh ladka?!

panels.action: Ha-Jun bows quickly in apology: 'M-Maaf kijiye!' (Thought: 'Mera wazan zameen se jud gaya hai.')

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mera sharir itna solid ho gaya hai...!

panels.action: Inside the train, concentric sound rings vibrate around Ha-Jun: He can hear fifty distinct heartbeats, whispering phones, and shoe squeaks.
System UI flashes: [PASSIVE UNLOCKED: DEMONIC AUDITORY ENHANCEMENT] | [FILTER CALIBRATING: 65%].
Ha-Jun breathes through his nose, focusing his core to suppress the sound waves until normal quiet returns.
The train doors slide open at Saint Mirren University station; student crowds surge onto the platform.
In Classroom 3-B, sunlight fills the room as students chat; Ha-Jun sits quietly at his corner window desk.

dialogue.text: Classroom 3-B. Wahi jagah jahan sab badal chuka tha.

panels.action: Ha-Jun holds a wooden pencil with feather-light touch, sweating slightly as he writes notes without snapping the lead.
Across the aisle two desks down, Min-Jae adjusts his glasses, his sharp gaze locked onto Ha-Jun's calm posture.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Kal chhat par kuch bohot ajeeb hua tha...

panels.action: The literature teacher at the chalkboard points: 'Kang Ha-Jun, page 42 ka paragraph 3 read karo.'
Ha-Jun stands up and begins reading: His voice carries an accidental, deep baritone resonance that vibrates the window panes.
All chatter instantly dies; every single student and the teacher freeze, goosebumps prickling on their arms.

dialogue.text: Uske gale se nikli aawaz ne sabko khamosh kar diya.

panels.action: Ha-Jun clears his throat, brings his voice back to normal student pitch, and quickly sits down with a reddening neck.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Gadbad ho gayi... meri aawaz mein bhi mana aa raha hai!

panels.action: Min-Jae discreetly slides a tightly folded piece of notebook paper across the wooden desk onto Ha-Jun's notebook.
Ha-Jun unfolds the paper under his desk: 'Class ke baad purane auditorium ke peeche milo. Mujhe pata hai kal tumne kya kiya.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: 'Mujhe pata hai kal tumne kya kiya.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun's heart hammers in his chest; his fingers crumple the note tightly in his palm.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Min-Jae ne kal mujhe dekh liya tha...!

panels.action: Before he can even breathe, a deafening holographic chime rings directly in Ha-Jun's skull: *DINGGGGGG!!*
A neon-violet system window materializes: [MANDATORY BLOODLINE QUEST: ENTER THE SUBTERRANEAN VOID] | [TIME LIMIT: 03:00:00].
The screen pulses crimson: [PENALTY UPON FAILURE: PERMANENT MANA COLLAPSE & GLOBAL EXPOSURE OF SOVEREIGN LINEAGE].

panels.shot: looking out window at dark auditorium cliffhanger
panels.action: Ha-Jun stares out the third-floor window toward the dilapidated Victorian auditorium where faint purple miasma leaks from basement vents: 'Is university ke neeche kuch chupa hai.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Is university ke neeche... koi purana raaz chupa hai.
